workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Their overlapping free 30-min slots next week are:
- Mon 09:00-10:00
- Tue 13:00-14:00 or 16:30-17:00
- Wed 15:00-16:00
- Thu 10:00-10:30
- Fri 11:00-12:00

Brad, please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars for these times and let me know which slots work for both of them. Then I'll create the booking.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against the slots you provided. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots work for both Elena and David:

- Mon 09:00-10:00: Elena is busy 09:00-09:30 and 09:30-10:00 (fully booked)
- Tue 13:00-14:00: Elena busy 13:00-14:00; David busy 13:00-14:00
- Tue 16:30-17:00: Elena busy 16:30-17:00; David busy 16:30-17:00
- Wed 15:00-16:00: David busy 15:00-15:30 and 15:30-16:00 (fully booked)
- Thu 10:00-10:30: Elena busy 10:00-10:30 (Hiring panel)
- Fri 11:00-12:00: Elena busy 11:00-12:00; David busy 11:00-12:00

None of the overlapping free slots for Priya and Marcus align with times when both Elena and David are also free. This appears to be infeasible - there is no 30-minute slot next week when all four partners are available.

Before we report infeasible, please double-check your analysis of Priya and Marcus's calendars to make sure we haven't missed any overlapping free slots.
